question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To read between the lines

options.text: To understand more than what the words suggest

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To read between the lines"** means to understand more than what the words suggest; it involves perceiving the hidden or underlying meaning behind the words. (शब्दों से अधिक समझना)

 
 
• **Example: **When she said she was fine, he read between the lines and knew she was actually upset.
 
 
 
• **"To underline some words"** refers to physically drawing a line under words for emphasis. (कुछ शब्दों को रेखांकित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher asked us to underline the important points in the text.
 
 
 
• **"To read differently"** refers to interpreting or understanding text in a different manner. (अलग तरीके से पढ़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **She read the poem differently, finding new meanings in the verses.
 
 
 
• **"To read aloud to public"** means to read something out loud for an audience to hear. (जनता के सामने जोर से पढ़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **The author read aloud her new book to the audience at the event.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To underline some words** (कुछ शब्दों को रेखांकित करना): Drawing a line under words for emphasis.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher asked us to underline the important points in the text.
 
 
 
• **To read differently** (अलग तरीके से पढ़ना): Interpreting or understanding text in a different manner.
 
 
• **Example: **She read the poem differently, finding new meanings in the verses.
 
 
 
• **To read aloud to public** (जनता के सामने जोर से पढ़ना): Reading something out loud for an audience to hear.
 
 
• **Example:** The author read aloud her new book to the audience at the event.
